I think I see how this can happen, it would be if the very first search is stalled, since this is the `search` event, not the `result` event

https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/blob/67407a0dfd99402bc1a77bd005385633c3881624/src/algoliasearch.helper.js#L1195-L1198

Would need to check if we already have a test for this though, I feel like not having results woful be a straightforward way to write this test.

We probably want to render `null` or something for the results, and not with && like here, since that will return a different object
